connector.name: MCP Atlassian Extended
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Jira and Confluence - sprints, agile boards, attachments, versions, calendars.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-atlassian-extended. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vish288 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
